Warrior.name: Bulwark
Warrior.description: Grants a chance to block incoming hits, halving their damage - 8% at rank 1, +6% per additional rank (20% at 3/3).

Warrior.name: Retaliation
Warrior.description: A hit taken has a chance to trigger an immediate counter-attack - 10% at rank 1, +8% per additional rank (26% at 3/3).

Warrior.name: Juggernaut
Warrior.description: Increases max HP by 8% per rank (up to 24% at 3/3).

Warrior.name: Aegis
Warrior.description: A blocked hit also shields your lowest-HP ally for 20% of the blocked damage, at rank 1 - +10% per rank (40% at 3/3).

Warrior.name: Spike Barrier
Warrior.description: A blocked hit reflects 25% of its damage back at the attacker at rank 1 - +15% per rank (55% at 3/3).

Warrior.name: Unbreakable

Warrior.name: Vengeance
Warrior.description: Retaliation's counter-attacks deal 20% increased damage at rank 1 - +15% per rank (50% at 3/3).

Warrior.name: Bloodied Resolve
Warrior.description: Retaliation's counter-attacks heal you for 8% of the damage dealt at rank 1 - +6% per rank (20% at 3/3).

Warrior.name: Last Stand
Warrior.description: Below 25% HP, Retaliation's trigger chance is increased by 25% at rank 1 - +15% per rank (55% at 3/3).

Warrior.name: Colossus

Warrior.name: Momentum
Warrior.description: Each hit lands a stacking +3% attack speed buff per rank for 4s, max 5 stacks - up to +9% per stack at 3/3 (45% at cap).

Warrior.name: Overwhelming Force
Warrior.description: Converts 10% of your current damage reduction into increased damage per rank (up to 30% at 3/3), on top of the existing overflow conversion.

Warrior.name: Bastion
Warrior.description: Aegis's shield lasts 1 additional second per rank (up to +3s at 3/3).

Warrior.name: Rally
Warrior.description: Aegis also grants the shielded ally +10% attack speed per rank for its duration (up to +30% at 3/3).

Warrior.name: Iron Circle
Warrior.description: Aegis shields 1 additional ally per rank (up to all 3 party members at 3/3).

Warrior.name: Thorned Hide
Warrior.description: Spike Barrier's reflected damage also applies a stacking -5% damage dealt debuff to the attacker per rank (up to -15% at 3/3).

Warrior.name: Retribution
Warrior.description: Reflected damage has a 20% chance per rank (up to 60% at 3/3) to crit for double.

Warrior.name: Unyielding
Warrior.description: Spike Barrier can also trigger on unblocked hits, at a 10% chance per rank (up to 30% at 3/3).

Warrior.name: Fortress
Warrior.description: Unbreakable's overflow conversion also grants flat damage reduction - 2% per rank (up to 6% at 3/3).

Warrior.name: Second Skin

Warrior.name: Stonewall

Warrior.name: Grudge

Warrior.name: Executioner's Mark
Warrior.description: Vengeance's counter-attacks gain +10% crit chance per rank (up to +30% at 3/3).

Warrior.description: Overwhelming Force's damage bonus also grants +5% attack speed per rank (up to +15% at 3/3).

Berserker.description: Each attack has a 10% chance to strike the same target additional times - rank 1 strikes twice total, rank 2 strikes three times total, rank 3 strikes four times total. The 10% rate itself doesn't scale with rank; only the strike count does.

Berserker.name: Reckless Swing

Berserker.name: Culling Strike

Berserker.name: Chain Frenzy

Berserker.name: Vitality Surge
Berserker.description: Bloodletting's heal is increased by another 3% of damage dealt per rank (up to +9% at 3/3, on top of Bloodletting's own +9%).

Berserker.name: Bloodshield
Berserker.description: A Bloodletting heal has a 15% chance per rank (up to 45% at 3/3) to also grant a shield worth 20% of the heal.

Berserker.name: Undying Fury
Berserker.description: Can't be reduced below 1 HP once per fight, unlocked at rank 2 - rank 3 grants a second use.

Berserker.name: Fury Unleashed
Berserker.description: Bloodlust's per-stack damage bonus is increased by 1% per rank (up to +3% per stack at 3/3).

Berserker.description: Bloodlust's stacks decay one at a time instead of all at once, per rank (fully gradual at 3/3).

Berserker.name: Warlord
Berserker.description: Reaching max Bloodlust stacks grants party members +3% increased damage per rank for 5s (up to +9% at 3/3).

Berserker.name: Shatter
Berserker.description: Overwhelm's damage reduction shred also applies to block chance, by the same amount per rank.

Berserker.description: Gambit's unused crit chance (above 80% HP, where missing-HP scaling can't apply) converts to +5% attack speed per rank instead (up to +15% at 3/3).

Berserker.name: Death Defiant
Berserker.description: Gambit's crit bonus persists 3 additional seconds per rank after healing back above its missing-HP threshold (up to 9s at 3/3).

Paladin.name: Guardian's Oath
Paladin.description: Increases intervene by 4% at rank 1 - +3% per rank (10% at 3/3).

Paladin.name: Divine Shield
Paladin.description: Every 8s, shields your lowest-HP ally for a flat 10% of your max HP. Each rank instead reduces the cooldown by 15% - up to -45% at 3/3 (~4.4s).

Paladin.name: Radiant Smite
Paladin.description: Every hit also heals up to 2 nearby allies (more with Splash) for 10% of your max HP at rank 1 - +10% per rank (30% at 3/3).

Paladin.name: Aegis Ward
Paladin.description: Intervene overflow past the 50% cap converts to damage reduction at 50% efficiency per rank, capped at +10% damage reduction per rank (up to +30% at 3/3). Counts your COMBINED gear + tree intervene, not tree investment alone - gear alone can easily push you past 50%.

Paladin.name: Vow of Protection
Paladin.description: Guardian's Oath also grants the whole party +3% damage reduction per rank (up to +9% at 3/3).

Paladin.name: Unbreakable Faith
Paladin.description: Damage redirected by intervene heals you for 5% of the redirected amount per rank (up to 15% at 3/3).

Paladin.name: Bulwark of Light
Paladin.description: Divine Shield's amount is increased by another 10% max HP per rank (up to +30% at 3/3, on top of the base 10%).

Paladin.name: Consecration
Paladin.description: Divine Shield also grants a smaller shield (40% value) to the rest of the party, +10% per rank (70% at 3/3).

Paladin.name: Retribution Aura
Paladin.description: When Divine Shield fully absorbs a hit, reflect 20% of the absorbed damage per rank (up to 60% at 3/3).

Paladin.name: Zealotry
Paladin.description: Radiant Smite heals for another 5% of your max HP per rank (up to +15% at 3/3) and reaches 1 additional target.

Paladin.name: Holy Fire
Paladin.description: Your total healing done each hit also deals damage to every enemy, equal to 5% of it at rank 1 - +5% per rank (15% at 3/3).

Paladin.name: Judgment
Paladin.description: Radiant Smite heals for another 10% of your max HP per rank (up to +30% at 3/3) whenever the enemy you're hitting is below 50% HP.

Paladin.name: Sanctified Armor
Paladin.description: A second, independent conversion channel off the same intervene overflow Aegis Ward draws from - damage reduction at 15% efficiency per rank, capped at +10% damage reduction per rank (up to +30% at 3/3, stacking with Aegis Ward's own cap for up to +60% total).

Paladin.name: Bonded Devotion
Paladin.description: Aegis Ward's conversion also grants the intervened ally +5% damage reduction per rank (up to +15% at 3/3).

Paladin.name: Steadfast
Paladin.description: Aegis Ward's damage reduction bonus persists for 2s per rank after intervene stops triggering (up to +6s at 3/3).

Paladin.name: Beacon of Light
Paladin.description: Vow of Protection's bonus is increased by another 3% per rank (up to +9% at 3/3).

Paladin.name: Hallowed Ground
Paladin.description: Vow of Protection also reduces damage taken from bosses specifically by another 3% per rank (up to +9% at 3/3).

Paladin.name: Unwavering
Paladin.description: Vow of Protection's bonus doubles for the party while you are below 50% HP, unlocked at rank 2 - rank 3 lowers this threshold to 65%.

Paladin.name: Martyr's Blessing
Paladin.description: Unbreakable Faith's self-heal is increased by another 5% per rank (up to +15% at 3/3).

Paladin.name: Gracious Burden
Paladin.description: Unbreakable Faith also heals the ally whose damage you redirected, for 5% of the redirected amount per rank (up to 15% at 3/3).

Paladin.name: Eternal Vow
Paladin.description: Unbreakable Faith's heal has a chance to also fully shield you for the same amount - 15% per rank (up to 45% at 3/3).

Paladin.name: Radiant Barrier
Paladin.description: Bulwark of Light's shield also grants +5% damage reduction per rank while active (up to +15% at 3/3) - same mechanism as Cleric's Balanced Faith (any active shield, not specifically a Bulwark-of-Light one).

Paladin.name: Grace Period
Paladin.description: Bulwark of Light's cooldown is reduced by another 10% per rank (up to -30% at 3/3), stacking with Divine Shield's own tier-1 reduction.

Paladin.name: Sacred Overflow
Paladin.description: Unused Bulwark of Light shield value converts to a heal at 50% efficiency per rank (up to 150% at 3/3) when it expires.

Paladin.name: Wider Blessing
Paladin.description: Consecration's value is increased by another 10% per rank (up to +30% at 3/3).

Paladin.name: Communion
Paladin.description: Consecration also grants the party +5% healing power per rank for its duration (up to +15% at 3/3).

Paladin.name: Shared Light
Paladin.description: Consecration's party shield lasts 2 additional seconds per rank (up to +6s at 3/3).

Paladin.name: Holy Vengeance
Paladin.description: Retribution Aura's reflect is increased by another 10% per rank (up to +30% at 3/3).

Paladin.name: Purify
Paladin.description: Retribution Aura also reduces the attacker's damage dealt by 5% per rank for 3s (up to -15% at 3/3).

Paladin.name: Last Judgment
Paladin.description: A fully-reflected hit has a chance per rank to skip the attacker's next action - 15% per rank (up to 45% at 3/3).

Paladin.name: Desperate Grace
Paladin.description: Zealotry's heal is increased by another 10% per rank to any target below 50% HP.

Paladin.name: United Front
Paladin.description: Zealotry's heal is increased by another 2% per rank per ally this cast actually reaches (up to +6%/rank at 3/3).

Paladin.name: Zealous Charge
Paladin.description: Healing an ally below 50% HP with Radiant Smite grants +5% attack speed per rank for 3s.

Paladin.name: Wildfire
Paladin.description: Holy Fire's conversion rate is increased by another 10% per rank (up to +30% at 3/3).

Paladin.name: Purging Flame
Paladin.description: Holy Fire's damage also reduces the struck enemy's healing received by 10% per rank (up to -30% at 3/3).

Paladin.name: Rising Blaze
Paladin.description: Holy Fire strikes 1 additional random enemy per rank (up to 3 extra hits at 3/3).

Paladin.name: Final Judgment
Paladin.description: Judgment's threshold is raised to 30% HP per rank instead of 20% (up to 40% at 3/3).

Paladin.name: Executioner's Blessing
Paladin.description: A Judgment kill heals you for 8% max HP per rank (up to 24% at 3/3).

Paladin.name: Wrath of the Heavens
Paladin.description: Judgment has a chance per rank to also splash 50% of its damage to nearby enemies - 20% per rank (up to 60% at 3/3).

Ranger.name: Multishot
Ranger.description: Increases splash by 8% at rank 1 - +6% per rank (20% at 3/3).

Ranger.name: Hunter's Mark
Ranger.description: Marks your target, granting +10% crit chance against it at rank 1 - +8% per rank (26% at 3/3).

Ranger.name: Fleet Step
Ranger.description: Increases attack speed by 6% at rank 1 - +4% per rank (14% at 3/3).

Ranger.name: Volley
Ranger.description: Deals 10% more damage per rank for every target this attack is capable of reaching (not how many it actually hits) - up to 30% per target at 3/3.

Ranger.name: Piercing Shots
Ranger.description: Splash damage can crit independently using your full crit chance/multiplier, unlocked at rank 2 - rank 3 also grants splash +10% crit chance.

Ranger.name: Explosive Tips
Ranger.description: Multishot's splash damage is increased by another 10% per rank (up to +30% at 3/3).

Ranger.name: Predator's Eye
Ranger.description: Hunter's Mark also grants +15% crit damage per rank against the marked target (up to +45% at 3/3).

Ranger.name: Pack Tactics
Ranger.description: Hunter's Mark also grants your allies +5% crit chance per rank against the marked target (up to +15% at 3/3).

Ranger.name: Kill Zone
Ranger.description: Hunter's Mark deals +20% damage per rank (up to +60% at 3/3) to the marked target below 25% HP.

Ranger.name: Rapid Fire
Ranger.description: Fleet Step's attack speed bonus is increased by another 6% per rank (up to +18% at 3/3).

Ranger.name: Evasive Maneuvers
Ranger.description: Fleet Step also grants +6% evasion per rank (up to +18% at 3/3).

Ranger.name: Relentless Pursuit
Ranger.description: Each hit grants a stacking +2% attack speed per rank for 3s, max 5 stacks (up to +6% per stack at 3/3).

Ranger.name: Chain Shot
Ranger.description: Volley's damage-per-target bonus is increased by another 10% per rank (up to +30% at 3/3) - boosts the whole attack, splash included.

Ranger.name: Deadeye
Ranger.description: +5% crit chance per rank (up to +15% at 3/3) - splash inherits it too, since splash always rolls off your same crit chance.

Ranger.name: Storm of Arrows
Ranger.description: Volley hits 1 additional guaranteed target per rank regardless of overflow (up to 3 extra at 3/3).

Ranger.name: Armor Breaker
Ranger.description: Piercing Shots' independent splash crit also reduces the target's damage reduction by 3% per rank (up to -9% at 3/3).

Ranger.name: Wind Pierce
Ranger.description: Piercing Shots' splash crit chance bonus is increased by another 5% per rank (up to +15% at 3/3).

Ranger.name: True Strike
Ranger.description: Piercing Shots' crit chance against your PRIMARY target (not splash) is increased by 10% per rank (up to +30% at 3/3).

Ranger.name: Wider Burst
Ranger.description: Explosive Tips hits 1 additional enemy per rank (up to 3 extra at 3/3).

Ranger.name: Scorched Earth
Ranger.description: Explosive Tips' splash also reduces enemy damage dealt by 5% per rank for 3s (up to -15% at 3/3).

Ranger.name: Overcharge
Ranger.description: Explosive Tips' bonus is increased by another 10% per rank (up to +30% at 3/3).

Ranger.name: Apex Hunter
Ranger.description: Predator's Eye's crit damage bonus is increased by another 10% per rank (up to +30% at 3/3).

Ranger.name: Trueshot
Ranger.description: Predator's Eye also grants +10% crit chance per rank against the marked target (up to +30% at 3/3).

Ranger.name: Hunter's Focus
Ranger.description: Predator's Eye's crit damage bonus also applies to allies' hits against the marked target, at 1/3 value per rank (up to full value at 3/3).

Ranger.name: Coordinated Strike
Ranger.description: Pack Tactics' bonus is increased by another 5% per rank (up to +15% at 3/3).

Ranger.name: Alpha's Predator
Ranger.description: Pack Tactics also grants allies +5% increased damage per rank against the marked target (up to +15% at 3/3).

Ranger.name: Wider Pack
Ranger.description: Hunter's Mark can affect 1 additional target simultaneously per rank (up to 3 marks at 3/3).

Ranger.name: Final Blow
Ranger.description: Kill Zone's threshold is raised to 35% HP per rank instead of 25% (up to 45% at 3/3).

Ranger.name: Clean Kill
Ranger.description: A Kill Zone kill immediately re-applies Hunter's Mark to a new target for free, at a chance per rank - 25% per rank (up to 75% at 3/3).

Ranger.name: Hunter's Reward
Ranger.description: A Kill Zone kill heals you for 6% max HP per rank (up to 18% at 3/3).

Ranger.name: Wind Sprint
Ranger.description: Rapid Fire's bonus is increased by another 5% per rank (up to +15% at 3/3).

Ranger.name: Quick Shot
Ranger.description: Rapid Fire also grants +3% splash per rank (up to +9% at 3/3).

Ranger.name: Fleeting Shadow
Ranger.description: Rapid Fire's bonus is doubled for 3s per rank after evading a hit (up to 9s at 3/3).

Ranger.name: Swift Wind
Ranger.description: Evasive Maneuvers' bonus is increased by another 5% per rank (up to +15% at 3/3).

Ranger.name: Vanishing Shot
Ranger.description: A successful evade grants your next hit +15% crit chance per rank (up to +45% at 3/3).

Ranger.name: Lightfoot
Ranger.description: Evasive Maneuvers' overflow past the 75% cap converts to attack speed at 50% efficiency per rank, capped at +10% attack speed per rank (up to +30% at 3/3). Counts your COMBINED gear + tree evasion, not tree investment alone - gear alone can easily push you past 75%.

Ranger.name: Windborn
Ranger.description: Relentless Pursuit's max stacks are increased by 1 per rank (up to 8 at 3/3, from the base 5).

Ranger.name: Hunter's Stride
Ranger.description: Relentless Pursuit's stacks also grant +2% splash per rank per stack (up to +6% per stack at 3/3).

Ranger.name: Never Winded
Ranger.description: Relentless Pursuit's stacks no longer decay once at max, per rank this holds for 2s longer after falling below max (up to 6s at 3/3).

Mage.name: Arcane Mastery
Mage.description: Increases crit damage dealt by 3% per rank (up to 9% at 3/3).

Mage.name: Spell Weaving
Mage.description: Increases attack speed by 5% at rank 1 - +4% per rank (13% at 3/3).

Mage.name: Elemental Surge
Mage.description: Increases splash by 8% at rank 1 - +6% per rank (20% at 3/3).

Mage.name: Critical Mass
Mage.description: Arcane Mastery also grants +4% crit chance per rank (up to +12% at 3/3).

Mage.name: Overload
Mage.description: Arcane Mastery's crit damage bonus is increased by another 3% per rank (up to +9% at 3/3).

Mage.name: Spell Echo
Mage.description: A crit has a chance to immediately cast again at 50% damage - 15% per rank (up to 45% at 3/3).

Mage.name: Quickcast
Mage.description: Spell Weaving's bonus is increased by another 5% per rank (up to +15% at 3/3).

Mage.name: Flow State
Mage.description: Each hit grants a stacking +2% attack speed per rank for 3s, max 5 stacks (up to +6% per stack at 3/3).

Mage.name: Temporal Rift
Mage.description: Attack speed above 100% total converts excess into increased damage at 30% efficiency per rank (up to 90% at 3/3).

Mage.name: Chain Lightning
Mage.description: Deals 10% more damage per rank for every target this attack is capable of reaching (not how many it actually hits) - up to 30% per target at 3/3.

Mage.name: Wildfire
Mage.description: Elemental Surge's splash damage is increased by another 10% per rank (up to +30% at 3/3).

Mage.name: Frost Nova
Mage.description: Elemental Surge's splash also reduces the target's evasion by 5% per rank (up to -15% at 3/3).

Mage.name: Mana Surge
Mage.description: Critical Mass's crit chance bonus is increased by another 3% per rank (up to +9% at 3/3).

Mage.name: Arcane Shield
Mage.description: A crit grants you a shield worth 5% max HP per rank (up to 15% at 3/3).

Mage.name: Empowered Bolt
Mage.description: Critical Mass's first hit each fight is a guaranteed crit, unlocked at rank 2 - rank 3 also grants it +20% crit damage.

Mage.name: Cataclysm
Mage.description: Overload's bonus is increased by another 3% per rank (up to +9% at 3/3).

Mage.name: Volatile Magic
Mage.description: A critical strike splashes 10% of its damage per rank to nearby enemies (up to 30% at 3/3) - this is not a hit and won't trigger any other on-hit effects.

Mage.name: Arcane Instability
Mage.description: Critical damage is increased by 5%/9%/12% (rank 1/2/3) against targets above 65% HP.

Mage.name: Echoing Power
Mage.description: Spell Echo's re-cast damage is increased from 50% per rank (up to 95% at 3/3).

Mage.name: Resonance
Mage.description: Spell Echo's trigger chance is increased by another 10% per rank (up to +30% at 3/3).

Mage.name: Finite Loop
Mage.description: Spell Echo's re-cast can itself trigger Spell Echo again, at the same chance as the first trigger - can repeat up to 3/6/9 times (rank 1/2/3) before the chain ends.

Mage.name: Haste
Mage.description: Quickcast's bonus is increased by another 5% per rank (up to +15% at 3/3).

Mage.name: Acceleration
Mage.description: Quickcast also grants +5% splash per rank (up to +15% at 3/3).

Mage.name: Timewarp
Mage.description: Quickcast's bonus is doubled for the first 5s of each fight, per rank this window extends by 2s (up to 11s at 3/3).

Mage.name: Perpetual Motion
Mage.description: Flow State's max stacks are increased by 1 per rank (up to 8 at 3/3, from the base 5).

Mage.name: Riptide
Mage.description: Flow State's stacks also grant +2% crit chance per rank per stack (up to +6% per stack at 3/3).

Mage.name: Unbroken Rhythm
Mage.description: Flow State's stacks no longer decay once at max, per rank this holds for 2s longer after falling below max (up to 6s at 3/3).

Mage.name: Dilation
Mage.description: Temporal Rift's conversion efficiency is increased by another 10% per rank (up to +30% at 3/3).

Mage.name: Paradox
Mage.description: Temporal Rift also converts excess attack speed into crit chance, at 15% efficiency per rank (up to 45% at 3/3).

Mage.name: Eternal Moment
Mage.description: Temporal Rift's threshold is lowered by 10% per rank, converting excess starting at 90%/80%/70% attack speed (70% at 3/3).

Mage.name: Thunderstruck
Mage.description: Chain Lightning's extra targets deal 10% more damage per rank (up to +30% at 3/3).

Mage.name: Static Field
Mage.description: Chain Lightning's splash also reduces the target's attack speed by 4% per rank (up to -12% at 3/3).

Mage.name: Stormcaller
Mage.description: Chain Lightning hits 1 additional guaranteed target per rank regardless of overflow (up to 3 extra at 3/3).

Mage.name: Conflagration
Mage.description: Wildfire's bonus is increased by another 10% per rank (up to +30% at 3/3).

Mage.name: Rising Heat
Mage.description: Wildfire's splash damage increases by 5% per rank for each enemy it hits, stacking (up to +15% per enemy at 3/3).

Mage.name: Infernal Pact
Mage.description: Wildfire also heals you for 3% max HP per rank per enemy hit (up to 9% per enemy at 3/3).

Mage.name: Blizzard
Mage.description: Frost Nova's evasion reduction is increased by another 5% per rank (up to -15% at 3/3).

Mage.name: Permafrost
Mage.description: Frost Nova's effect lasts 2 additional seconds per rank (up to +6s at 3/3).

Mage.name: Absolute Zero
Mage.description: Frost Nova's evasion reduction is doubled against enemies below 50% HP, unlocked at rank 2 - rank 3 lowers this threshold to 65%.

Warlock.name: Dark Pact
Warlock.description: Increases attack speed by 6% at rank 1 - +4% per rank (14% at 3/3).

Warlock.name: Curse of Weakness
Warlock.description: Curses your target, increasing damage they take by 8% at rank 1 - +6% per rank (20% at 3/3).

Warlock.name: Soul Siphon
Warlock.description: Grants 1% life leech per rank (3% at 3/3) - a slice of your damage dealt heals you back, same mechanism as gear's Leech affix.

Warlock.name: Fel Haste
Warlock.description: Dark Pact's bonus is increased by another 6% per rank (up to +18% at 3/3).

Warlock.name: Unstable Power
Warlock.description: Attack speed above 100% total converts excess into increased damage at 30% efficiency per rank (up to 90% at 3/3).

Warlock.name: Fel Rush
Warlock.description: A kill grants +8% attack speed per rank for 4s (up to +24% at 3/3).

Warlock.name: Amplify Curse
Warlock.description: Curse of Weakness's damage taken bonus is increased by another 8% per rank (up to +24% at 3/3).

Warlock.name: Contagious Curse
Warlock.description: Curse of Weakness spreads to 1 additional nearby enemy per rank (up to 3 total at 3/3).

Warlock.name: Doom
Warlock.description: Curse of Weakness detonates for a burst of damage when it expires, equal to 2% of damage dealt to the cursed target per rank (up to 6% at 3/3).

Warlock.name: Soul Harvest
Warlock.description: A kill heals you for 6% max HP per rank (up to 18% at 3/3), on top of Soul Siphon's per-hit heal.

Warlock.name: Life Tap
Warlock.description: Convert 3% of your max HP per rank into +6% increased damage instead, drained once at the start of each fight (up to -9% HP / +18% damage at 3/3).

Warlock.name: Dark Communion
Warlock.description: Soul Siphon's heal also applies to your lowest-HP ally, at 50% value per rank (up to 150% at 3/3).

Warlock.name: Chaos Bolt
Warlock.description: Fel Haste's bonus also grants +5% crit chance per rank (up to +15% at 3/3).

Warlock.name: Burning Rage
Warlock.description: Fel Haste's bonus is increased by another 5% per rank (up to +15% at 3/3).

Warlock.name: Demonic Speed
Warlock.description: Fel Haste's bonus is doubled for the first 5s of each fight, per rank this window extends 2s (up to 11s at 3/3).

Warlock.name: Void Energy
Warlock.description: Unstable Power's conversion efficiency is increased by another 10% per rank (up to +30% at 3/3).

Warlock.name: Entropic Force
Warlock.description: Unstable Power also converts excess into splash, at 15% efficiency per rank (up to 45% at 3/3).

Warlock.name: Chaos Theory
Warlock.description: Unstable Power's threshold is lowered by 10% per rank, converting excess starting at 90%/80%/70% attack speed (70% at 3/3).

Warlock.name: Warp Speed
Warlock.description: Fel Rush's duration is increased by 2s per rank (up to +6s at 3/3).

Warlock.name: Death March
Warlock.description: Fel Rush's bonus is increased by another 8% per rank (up to +24% at 3/3).

Warlock.name: Ravage
Warlock.description: Each kill while Fel Rush is active refreshes its full duration, unlocked at rank 2 - rank 3 also stacks its bonus additively.

Warlock.name: Withering Curse
Warlock.description: Amplify Curse also reduces the target's healing received by 10% per rank (up to -30% at 3/3).

Warlock.name: Hex Mastery
Warlock.description: Amplify Curse's bonus is increased by another 8% per rank (up to +24% at 3/3).

Warlock.name: Cursed Blood
Warlock.description: Immediately applies Curse of Weakness to 1 enemy per rank at the start of every fight (up to 3 at 3/3), before you've even landed a hit. Bypasses defenses entirely \u{2014} guaranteed to land, no evasion or damage reduction can stop it.

Warlock.name: Plague of Locusts
Warlock.description: Contagious Curse spreads to 1 additional enemy per rank (up to 3 more at 3/3, 6 total possible at 3/3).

Warlock.name: Epidemic
Warlock.description: Contagious Curse's spread copies deal 15% more damage per rank (up to +45% at 3/3).

Warlock.name: Soul Stone
Warlock.description: Cursing an enemy creates a Soul Stone (up to 1 per rank, 3 max at 3/3). While holding one, a killing blow instead heals you to full HP and consumes a stone - but stacks a permanent 33% reduction to your own hit damage for each stone used that fight.

Warlock.name: Harbinger
Warlock.description: Doom's detonation damage is increased by another 15% per rank (up to +45% at 3/3).

Warlock.name: Dreadful Death
Warlock.description: Doom's detonation also reduces the target's damage reduction by 5% per rank for 3s (up to -15% at 3/3).

Warlock.name: Apocalypse
Warlock.description: Doom's detonation splashes to nearby enemies at 30% value per rank (up to 90% at 3/3).

Warlock.name: Reaping
Warlock.description: Soul Harvest's heal is increased by another 4% per rank (up to +12% at 3/3).

Warlock.name: Dark Ritual
Warlock.description: Soul Harvest also grants +5% increased damage per rank for 5s after a kill (up to +15% at 3/3).

Warlock.name: Eternal Hunger
Warlock.description: Soul Harvest's heal is guaranteed to also grant a small shield worth 25% of the heal per rank (up to 75% at 3/3).

Warlock.name: Pain Bond
Warlock.description: Life Tap's HP cost is reduced by 1% per rank (up to -3% at 3/3) without lowering the damage bonus.

Warlock.name: Demonic Resilience
Warlock.description: Life Tap also grants +5% damage reduction per rank for the rest of the fight (up to +15% at 3/3).

Warlock.name: Soul Exchange
Warlock.description: Life Tap's damage bonus is increased by another 4% per rank (up to +12% at 3/3).

Warlock.name: Shared Suffering
Warlock.description: Dark Communion's value is increased by another 25% per rank (up to +75% at 3/3).

Warlock.name: Covenant
Warlock.description: Dark Communion also applies to your 2nd-lowest-HP ally, unlocked at rank 2 (half value) - rank 3 brings it to full value.

Warlock.name: Unbreakable Bond
Warlock.description: Dark Communion's heal also grants the ally +5% damage reduction per rank for 3s (up to +15% at 3/3).

Cleric.name: Divine Grace
Cleric.description: Increases healing power by 20% at rank 1 - +16% per rank (52% at 3/3).

Cleric.name: Prayer of Mending
Cleric.description: Your heals have a chance to also chain to another hurt ally for 50% of the primary heal's value (Merciful Touch scales this further; without it, 50% is the flat baseline) - 15% chance at rank 1, +10% per rank (35% at 3/3).

Cleric.name: Blessed Resilience
Cleric.description: Grants the WHOLE party (yourself included) +4% max HP at rank 1 - +3% per rank (10% at 3/3).

Cleric.name: Radiant Light
Cleric.description: Divine Grace's bonus is increased by another 16% per rank (up to +48% at 3/3) - a second, independent stack of healing power, not a multiplier on Divine Grace's own.

Cleric.name: Overflowing Grace
Cleric.description: Overheal - the part of a heal that would exceed the target's max HP - no longer wastes, instead becoming a temporary shield (lasting 5s, before Rift of Mercy) worth this fraction of the overheal: 10% at rank 1, +10% per rank (30% at 3/3).

Cleric.name: Sanctified Touch
Cleric.description: Unlocked at rank 2: a heal that crits deals 50% more, on top of your normal crit multiplier. Rank 3 also adds a flat +10% crit chance for the heal roll specifically (your attack share's crit chance is untouched). Rank 1 alone does nothing yet.

Cleric.name: Chain of Light
Cleric.description: Prayer of Mending chains through 1 additional ally per point invested (2 total targets at rank 1, up to 4 at rank 3) - each reached target gets the full bounce value, not a diminishing one.

Cleric.name: Merciful Touch
Cleric.description: Once invested, overrides Prayer of Mending's flat 50% bounce value with its own scaling: 50% at rank 1, +15% per rank (80% at 3/3).

Cleric.name: Divine Favor
Cleric.description: Each Prayer of Mending bounce also shields its target (5s, before Warding Light) for this fraction of the bounce heal's value: 20% at rank 1, +20% per rank (60% at 3/3).

Cleric.name: Sanctuary
Cleric.description: Blessed Resilience also grants the whole party +3% damage reduction per rank (up to +9% at 3/3).

Cleric.name: Guardian Spirit
Cleric.description: Unlocked at rank 2: once per fight, prevent ANY party member from dying (yourself included) - heals them for 20% max HP instead of letting the killing blow land. Rank 3 grants a second use per fight. Rank 1 alone does nothing yet.

Cleric.name: Radiant Aegis
Cleric.description: Blessed Resilience also grants the whole party +4% evasion per rank (up to +12% at 3/3).

Cleric.name: Luminous
Cleric.description: Radiant Light's bonus is increased by another 16% per rank (up to +48% at 3/3) - same independent healing-power stack as Radiant Light itself.

Cleric.name: Gracious Spirit
Cleric.description: +3% healing power per rank (up to +9% at 3/3), applied only to your PRIMARY heal share each turn - it always targets the lowest-HP hurt ally by construction, so this never reaches splash/bounce targets.

Cleric.name: Eternal Light
Cleric.description: Every heal you land grants +16% per rank healing power for 3s - keep casting and it never drops, but a gap longer than 3s lets it lapse.

Cleric.name: Gracious Overflow
Cleric.description: Overflowing Grace's shield value is increased by another 10% of the overheal per rank (up to +30% at 3/3).

Cleric.name: Balanced Faith
Cleric.description: While Overflowing Grace's shield is still active on a unit, they get +10% damage reduction per rank (up to +30% at 3/3).

Cleric.name: Rift of Mercy
Cleric.description: The shield's duration before it decays is increased by 2s per rank (up to +6s at 3/3, from the base 5s).

Cleric.name: Holy Crit
Cleric.description: Sanctified Touch's crit-heal bonus climbs from its 50% base by another 10% per rank (60% at rank 1, up to 80% at 3/3).

Cleric.name: Divine Clarity
Cleric.description: Sanctified Touch's rank-3 heal crit chance bonus is increased by another 5% per rank (up to +15% at 3/3, on top of the base +10%).

Cleric.name: Radiance
Cleric.description: A critical heal also splashes 20% of its value per rank to the rest of the party (up to 60% at 3/3) - separate from, and on top of, your normal gear-based Splash.

Cleric.name: Widening Circle
Cleric.description: Chain of Light can bounce to 1 additional ally per rank, further (up to 2 more at 3/3, on top of its base extra bounce).

Cleric.name: Swift Mending
Cleric.description: Prayer of Mending's bounce chance is increased by another 10% per rank (up to +30% at 3/3).

Cleric.name: Unbroken Prayer
Cleric.description: Chain of Light's bounces can themselves bounce again, at a 15% chance per rank (up to 45% at 3/3).

Cleric.name: Gentle Touch
Cleric.description: Merciful Touch's bounce value is increased by another 5% per rank (up to +15% at 3/3), on top of whichever base is active.

Cleric.name: Compassion
Cleric.description: Merciful Touch prioritizes the lowest-HP ally for its bounce - rank 2 guarantees this, rank 3 also grants that ally +5% damage reduction for 3s.

Cleric.name: Healing Touch
Cleric.description: Each bounced ally gets their own temporary +5% healing power per rank for 3s (up to +15% at 3/3).

Cleric.name: Aegis of Mercy
Cleric.description: Divine Favor's shield value is increased by another 10% per rank (up to +30% at 3/3).

Cleric.name: Warding Light
Cleric.description: Divine Favor's shield lasts 2 additional seconds per rank (up to +6s at 3/3, from the base 5s).

Cleric.name: Sacred Barrier
Cleric.description: Divine Favor's shield has a chance per rank to also reflect 20% of absorbed damage - 15% per rank (up to 45% at 3/3).

Cleric.name: Consecrated Earth
Cleric.description: Sanctuary's party damage reduction bonus is increased by another 3% per rank (up to +9% at 3/3).

Cleric.name: Warding Prayer
Cleric.description: Sanctuary also reduces damage taken from bosses specifically by another 3% per rank (up to +9% at 3/3).

Cleric.name: Unyielding Faith
Cleric.description: Sanctuary's bonus doubles for the party while you are below 50% HP, unlocked at rank 2 - rank 3 lowers this threshold to 65%.

Cleric.name: Second Chance
Cleric.description: Guardian Spirit's save heal is increased by another 8% max HP per rank (up to +24% at 3/3, on top of the base 20%).

Cleric.name: Divine Intervention
Cleric.description: Guardian Spirit's save also grants the saved unit +10% damage reduction per rank for 5s (up to +30% at 3/3).

Cleric.name: Final Blessing
Cleric.description: Guardian Spirit's save also grants the WHOLE party +5% healing power per rank for 5s afterward (up to +15% at 3/3), not just the saved unit.

Cleric.name: Winds of Grace
Cleric.description: Radiant Aegis's party evasion bonus is increased by another 4% per rank (up to +12% at 3/3).

Cleric.name: Swift Blessing
Cleric.description: Radiant Aegis also grants the whole party +3% attack speed per rank (up to +9% at 3/3).

Cleric.name: Haloed Steps
Cleric.description: Radiant Aegis's overflow past the 75% cap converts to party damage reduction at 30% efficiency per rank (up to 90% at 3/3).

Druid.name: Regrowth
Druid.description: Increases healing power at the same rate as Cleric's Divine Grace - 20% at rank 1, +16% per rank (52% at 3/3) - PLUS its own separate multiplicative healing power increase on top: +10% per rank (up to +30% at 3/3, stacking multiplicatively with everything else, gear included).

Druid.name: Predator's Instinct
Druid.description: Increases evasion by 6% at rank 1 - +4% per rank (14% at 3/3).

Druid.name: Thorned Barrier
Druid.description: A multiplicative damage reduction increase - 5% at rank 1, +5% per rank (15% at 3/3).

Druid.name: Rejuvenation
Druid.description: Regrowth's heals have a chance to also heal a second ally for 50% value - 15% at rank 1, +10% per rank (35% at 3/3).

Druid.name: Wild Surge
Druid.description: Healing Power above 100% already shortens your action interval instead of making individual heals bigger - Wild Surge shortens it FURTHER, by another 8% per rank (up to 24% faster at 3/3, stacking with the base effect).

Druid.name: Nature's Blessing
Druid.description: Increases crit chance by 10% at rank 1 - +10% per rank (30% at 3/3).

Druid.name: Feral Reflexes
Druid.description: Predator's Instinct's bonus is increased by another 6% per rank (up to +18% at 3/3).

Druid.name: Shifting Form
Druid.description: Evasion overflow past the 75% cap converts to increased damage at 50% efficiency per rank, capped at +10% increased damage per rank (up to +30% at 3/3). Counts your COMBINED gear + tree evasion, not tree investment alone - gear alone can easily push you past 75%.

Druid.name: Pack Instinct
Druid.description: Predator's Instinct also grants your lowest-HP ally +4% evasion per rank (up to +12% at 3/3).

Druid.name: Living Armor
Druid.description: Thorned Barrier's bonus is increased by another 5% per rank (up to +15% at 3/3).

Druid.name: Bramblegrowth
Druid.description: A hit reduced by Thorned Barrier reflects 15% of the reduced damage back at the attacker per rank (up to 45% at 3/3). In practice this reads off the hit's TOTAL reduction (all combined DR/block sources, not just Thorned Barrier's own slice) as long as Thorned Barrier is invested - isolating one source's specific share of an already-combined reduction isn't something the combat sim tracks.

Druid.name: Werebear
Druid.description: Grants Thick Hide: every 6 seconds at rank 1, removes any debuffs enemies have inflicted on you - the cycle shortens to every 5s at rank 2, every 4s at rank 3.

Druid.name: Blooming Field
Druid.description: A second, independent multiplicative healing power increase, separate from Regrowth's own - +10% per rank (up to +30% at 3/3, stacking multiplicatively with everything else, gear included).

Druid.name: Evergrowth
Druid.description: Converts a slice of your TOTAL healing power directly into Lingering Effect - 3% at rank 1, +3% per rank (9% at 3/3). E.g. at 1000% healing power, 3/3 Evergrowth alone grants 90% Lingering Effect.

Druid.name: Seed of Life
Druid.description: Every tick of your own Lingering Effect heals also grants the target a stacking shield, at the same rate - 10% of the tick's own heal amount at rank 1, +10% per rank (30% at 3/3).

Druid.name: Overgrowth
Druid.description: Wild Surge's extra interval reduction is increased by another 5% per rank (up to +15% at 3/3).

Druid.name: Primal Force
Druid.description: A flat, unconditional multiplicative splash increase - +10% per rank (up to +30% at 3/3, stacking multiplicatively with everything else, gear included).

Druid.name: Wild Heart
Druid.description: A slice of any healing you land on someone ELSE also heals you - 10% at rank 1, +10% per rank (30% at 3/3).

Druid.name: Bloom Strike
Druid.description: A second, independent crit chance increase, on top of Nature's Blessing's own - +10% per rank (up to +30% at 3/3).

Druid.name: Wild Instinct
Druid.description: Any heal you land also grants its target a temporary multiplicative damage reduction - 3% at rank 1, +3% per rank (9% at 3/3), for 3s.

Druid.name: Verdant Burst
Druid.description: If a hit would kill an ally who's currently affected by your own Lingering Effect healing, and your pending Lingering Effect healing on them exceeds the blow's damage, they survive at 1 HP instead. 1 use per fight at rank 1, +1 per rank (3 uses at 3/3).

Druid.name: Quick Paw
Druid.description: Feral Reflexes' bonus is increased by another 5% per rank (up to +15% at 3/3).

Druid.name: Silent Prowl
Druid.description: A successful evade grants +10% crit chance per rank on your next hit (up to +30% at 3/3).

Druid.name: Wild Agility
Druid.description: Feral Reflexes also grants +3% attack speed per rank (up to +9% at 3/3).

Druid.name: Primal Shift
Druid.description: A second, independent conversion channel off the same evasion overflow Shifting Form draws from - increased damage at 15% efficiency per rank, capped at +10% increased damage per rank (up to +30% at 3/3, stacking with Shifting Form's own cap for up to +60% total).

Druid.name: Claw Strike
Druid.description: Shifting Form also converts a portion of overflow into crit chance, at 20% efficiency per rank, capped at +10% crit chance per rank (up to +30% at 3/3).

Druid.name: Wild Fury
Druid.description: An evaded hit has a chance to trigger an immediate free attack - 10% per rank (up to 30% at 3/3).

Druid.name: Pathfinder
Druid.description: Pack Instinct's bonus is increased by another 4% per rank (up to +12% at 3/3).

Druid.name: United Pack
Druid.description: Pack Instinct protects 1 additional ally per rank (up to all 3 party members at 3/3).

Druid.name: Wild Guardian
Druid.description: Pack Instinct also heals the protected ally for 2% max HP per rank, once every 5s (up to 6% at 3/3).

Druid.name: Ironbark
Druid.description: Adds directly to Thorned Barrier's own multiplicative damage reduction - +5% per rank (up to +15% at 3/3, 10/20/30% combined total with Thorned Barrier's own).

Druid.name: Nature's Ward
Druid.description: A multiplicative damage reduction increase specifically against boss attacks - 3% at rank 1, +3% per rank (9% at 3/3).

Druid.name: Unyielding Roots
Druid.description: Forces every boss attack to target you specifically for 2 out of every 8 seconds at rank 1 - the cycle shortens to every 6s at rank 2, every 4s at rank 3 (same 2s taunt window each time).

Druid.name: Thornlash
Druid.description: Bramblegrowth's reflect is increased by another 10% per rank (up to +30% at 3/3).

Druid.name: Poison Thorns
Druid.description: Bramblegrowth's reflect also reduces the attacker's damage dealt by 5% per rank for 3s (up to -15% at 3/3).

Druid.name: Entangle
Druid.description: Bramblegrowth's reflect has a chance per rank to also apply to a second attacker if multiple enemies hit you that turn - 15% per rank (up to 45% at 3/3).

Druid.name: Rooted Network
Druid.description: Thick Hide also protects 1 additional party member per rank (up to 3 at 3/3), PLUS 1 more for every 100% splash you have.

Druid.name: Wild Roar
Druid.description: Whenever a party member dies, fear every enemy for 1 second (unable to act). 1 use per fight at rank 1, +1 per rank (3 uses at 3/3).

Druid.name: Nature's Embrace
Druid.description: Whenever a party member dies, instantly and fully heals the lowest-HP other party members - 1 at rank 1, +1 per rank (3 at 3/3).

Slayer.name: Open Wound
Slayer.description: Hits apply a stacking wound (max 5 stacks, before Blood Debt). Each stack adds 0.4% leech against that target at rank 1, +0.2% per additional rank - 0.6% per stack at rank 2, 0.8% per stack at rank 3 (up to 4.0% total leech at 5 stacks). Blends into your normal life leech, still capped by the same leech-per-second cap.

Slayer.name: Vampiric Frenzy
Slayer.description: Reduces FlickerStrike's cooldown by 12% at rank 1 - +8% per additional rank (28% at 3/3, ~3.6s from the base 5s). Folds the real, already-shipped FlickerStrike ability into the tree.

Slayer.name: Bloodpact
Slayer.description: Automatically fires every 4s of the fight once available (no live input needed during an auto-battle): sacrifice 10% of your CURRENT HP at rank 1 - cost drops 2% per additional rank (6% HP at rank 3) - to deal double damage on that hit. Triple damage at rank 2, quadruple at rank 3. The sacrifice can never drop you below 1 HP.

Slayer.name: Festering Wound
Slayer.description: Wound stacks last 25% longer at rank 1 (7.5s, up from the base 6s) and spread to your splash targets - +25% per additional rank (75% longer at 3/3, 10.5s).

Slayer.name: Hemorrhage
Slayer.description: When a wound reaches max stacks, it explodes for 10% of all the damage you've dealt to that target since the wound was first applied, at rank 1 - +10% per additional rank (30% at 3/3).

Slayer.name: Necrotic Grip
Slayer.description: While wounded, an enemy deals 10% less damage per rank (up to -30% at 3/3) on their own hits.

Slayer.name: Blood Frenzy
Slayer.description: Each FlickerStrike dash grants +15% attack speed per rank for 4s (up to +45% at 3/3).

Slayer.name: Endless Thirst
Slayer.description: Each FlickerStrike dash raises your leech cap by +5% max HP/sec per rank for 4s - at 3/3 the cap is removed entirely instead of +15%.

Slayer.name: Reaper's Momentum
Slayer.description: A kill from FlickerStrike adds 1 bonus target to your next dash per rank (up to 3 extra targets at 3/3).

Slayer.name: Grim Bargain
Slayer.description: A killing Bloodpact hit refunds 30% of the HP sacrificed for that use, at rank 1 - +20% per additional rank (70% refunded at 3/3).

Slayer.name: Blood Sacrifice
Slayer.description: Bloodpact's cooldown is reduced by 0.5s per point invested (3.5s at rank 1, down to 2s at rank 3+), so it fires more often across the fight.

Slayer.name: Martyrdom
Slayer.description: Bloodpact instead shields your lowest-HP ally for 15s, worth 150% of the sacrificed HP at rank 1 - +50% per additional rank (250% at 3/3).

Slayer.name: Rot
Slayer.description: Wound stacks also reduce enemy healing received by 10% per rank (up to -30% at 3/3).

Slayer.name: Contagion
Slayer.description: A wound has a 25% chance per rank (up to 75% at 3/3) to jump to a new target when its host dies.

Slayer.name: Blood Debt
Slayer.description: Raises max wound stacks by 1 per rank (up to 8 stacks at 3/3, from the base 5).

Slayer.name: Overflow
Slayer.description: Hemorrhage's explosion also leeches 20% of its damage for the Slayer, per rank (up to 60% at 3/3). This self-leech bypasses the normal leech-per-second cap.

Slayer.name: Arterial Spray
Slayer.description: The explosion hits 1 additional nearby enemy per rank (up to 3 extra at 3/3).

Slayer.name: Second Wind
Slayer.description: A 15% chance per rank (up to 45% at 3/3) for the explosion to fully reset Bloodpact's cooldown.

Slayer.name: Withering Touch
Slayer.description: Also reduces wounded enemies' healing received, invested and scaling separately from Rot - 10% per rank (up to -30% at 3/3).

Slayer.name: Plague Bearer
Slayer.description: The damage penalty spreads to 1 additional nearby enemy per rank (up to 3 at 3/3).

Slayer.name: Grave Chill
Slayer.description: Wounded enemies are also slowed by 8% per rank (up to -24% at 3/3).

Slayer.name: Unrelenting
Slayer.description: Blood Frenzy's attack speed bonus decays 33% slower per rank - stops decaying entirely at 3/3.

Slayer.name: War Cry
Slayer.description: Blood Frenzy also grants nearby allies +5% attack speed per rank (up to +15% at 3/3).

Slayer.name: Adrenaline
Slayer.description: FlickerStrike's dash hits deal +20% crit damage per rank (up to +60% at 3/3).

Slayer.name: Overflow Vessel
Slayer.description: Leech beyond the cap becomes a 5-second shield worth 25% of the overcap amount per rank (up to 75% at 3/3).

Slayer.name: Insatiable
Slayer.description: Each FlickerStrike hit has a 10% chance per rank (up to 30% at 3/3) to extend Endless Thirst's leech-cap bonus by 2s.

Slayer.name: Second Heartbeat
Slayer.description: A 20% chance per rank (up to 60% at 3/3) for a FlickerStrike hit to trigger an immediate bonus dash at one random additional enemy.

Slayer.name: Chain Reaper
Slayer.description: Each bonus target granted by Reaper's Momentum also heals you for 3% of max HP per rank (up to 9% at 3/3).

Slayer.name: Death Spiral
Slayer.description: A kill from one of Reaper's Momentum's bonus dash targets heals a flat 4% of max HP per rank (up to 12% at 3/3).

Slayer.name: Undying
Slayer.description: Can't drop below 1 HP during a FlickerStrike dash - once per fight at rank 1, twice at rank 3.

Slayer.name: Blood for Blood
Slayer.description: Grim Bargain's refund scales up by 2% of the target's max HP per rank (up to +6% at 3/3), on top of its base refund.

Slayer.name: Debt Collector
Slayer.description: A non-lethal Bloodpact hit still refunds 15% of the sacrificed HP per rank (up to 45% at 3/3).

Slayer.name: Clean Slate
Slayer.description: A successful Grim Bargain refund has a 25% chance per rank (up to 75% at 3/3) to also fully reset Bloodpact's cooldown.

Slayer.name: Triage
Slayer.description: Each prior Bloodpact use this fight discounts the NEXT use's HP cost by 3% per rank (up to -9% per prior use at 3/3).

Slayer.name: Warlord's Resolve
Slayer.description: Bloodpact's 3rd use also grants the party +5% damage per rank for 10s (up to +15% at 3/3).

Slayer.name: Final Offering
Slayer.description: Once you've used Bloodpact enough times this fight (the 4th use at rank 1, 3rd at rank 2, 2nd at rank 3), every use after that costs 33% less HP - combined with Triage's own discount, capped together at 90% off.

Slayer.name: Guardian's Blood
Slayer.description: Martyrdom's shield also reflects 10% of absorbed damage per rank (up to 30% at 3/3) back at the attacker.

Slayer.name: Shared Pain
Slayer.description: Shielding an ally also heals you for 25% of the shield's value per rank (up to 75% at 3/3).

Slayer.name: Last Rites
Slayer.description: A 33% chance per rank (up to 100% at 3/3) to prevent a downed ally's death once per fight.

Elementalist.name: Righteous Fire
Elementalist.description: Deals damage equal to 10% of your maximum health to a number of enemies based on splash, at rank 1 - +10% per additional rank (30% at 3/3). While active, you take 10% of your health as damage per second at rank 1 - +10% per additional rank (30% at 3/3).

Elementalist.name: Elemental Focus
Elementalist.description: Gain 5% additive elemental damage (lightning/cold/fire) × your character level, at rank 1 - +5% per additional rank (15% at 3/3). Applies in full to each element separately.

Elementalist.name: Golem Master
Elementalist.description: Grants the ability to summon 1 golem at rank 1 - +1 per additional rank (3 golems at 3/3). Golems have 33% of your stats; you deal 33% less damage per summoned golem, additive (1% of normal damage at 3 golems).

Elementalist.name: Healing Flames
Elementalist.description: Regenerate 3% of your health per second at rank 1, 6% at rank 2, 10% at rank 3 (irregular scaling - see this file's own note above).

Elementalist.name: Cleansing Flames
Elementalist.description: 33% chance every 4 seconds to remove all debuffs from yourself and nearby allies at rank 1, 66% at rank 2, 100% at rank 3 - target count based on splash.

Elementalist.name: Scorching Flames
Elementalist.description: Gain 10% additive fire damage × your character level, at rank 1 - +10% per additional rank (30% at 3/3).

Elementalist.name: Shocking Focus
Elementalist.description: You apply lightning damage debuffs 33% more frequently at rank 1, 66% at rank 2, 100% at rank 3.

Elementalist.name: Chilling Focus
Elementalist.description: You apply cold damage debuffs 33% more frequently at rank 1, 66% at rank 2, 100% at rank 3.

Elementalist.name: Scorching Focus
Elementalist.description: You apply fire damage debuffs 33% more frequently at rank 1, 66% at rank 2, 100% at rank 3.

Elementalist.name: Thunder Golem
Elementalist.description: Absorbs all externally-sourced damage the party would take until it dies (cannot be shielded or healed by any means) - reforms 4 seconds after dying at rank 1, 3 seconds at rank 2, 2 seconds at rank 3, then rejoins combat.

Elementalist.name: Flame Golem
Elementalist.description: All of your increases to elemental damage are multiplicatively increased by 1.33x at rank 1, 1.66x at rank 2, 2.0x at rank 3 - this multiplied scaling applies to your Flame Golems as well, via inheritance.

Elementalist.name: Water Golem
Elementalist.description: Water Golems regenerate 3% of their own max health per second to ALL party members at rank 1, 6% at rank 2, 9% at rank 3 (non-stacking across multiple Water Golems - highest rank applies once).

Elementalist.name: Fanning Flames
Elementalist.description: Share 33% of your Healing Flames regeneration with nearby allies at rank 1, 66% at rank 2, 100% at rank 3 - target count based on splash.

Elementalist.name: Rising Phoenix
Elementalist.description: When nearby allies die, up to 1 of them revives and rejoins the battle 1 second after death at rank 1 - +1 per additional rank (3 at 3/3, a per-combat limit). Only applies to allies that had survived at least 3 seconds.

Elementalist.name: Shielding Flames
Elementalist.description: 33% of your Healing Flames regeneration is also added as a shield on you at rank 1, 66% at rank 2, 100% at rank 3 - in addition to the healing.

Elementalist.name: Enshrouded Fire
Elementalist.description: Grants a number of allies (based on splash) 3% multiplicative evasion at rank 1 - +3% per additional rank (9% at 3/3).

Elementalist.name: Guardian Fire
Elementalist.description: Grants a number of allies (based on splash) 3% multiplicative reduced damage taken at rank 1 - +3% per additional rank (9% at 3/3).

Elementalist.name: Shielding Fire
Elementalist.description: Grants a number of allies (based on splash) improved block: blocked attacks reduce damage by 55% at rank 1, 60% at rank 2, 65% at rank 3, instead of the standard 50%.

Elementalist.name: Relentless Flames
Elementalist.description: A number of nearby enemies (based on splash) take 1% increased damage per second for every second they remain in your presence at rank 1 - +1% per additional rank (3% at 3/3), stacking.

Elementalist.name: Cauterizing Flames
Elementalist.description: A number of nearby enemies (based on splash) receive 5% multiplicative reduced healing at rank 1 - +5% per additional rank (15% at 3/3).

Elementalist.name: Ashes to Ashes, Dust to Dust
Elementalist.description: Any enemy in range, including bosses, instantly bursts into flame and dies when its health drops below 100% of your health at rank 1 - +100% per additional rank (300% at 3/3).

Elementalist.name: Overshock
Elementalist.description: 15% more lightning damage at rank 1 - +15% per additional rank (45% at 3/3), scaling from lightning damage on your gear.

Elementalist.name: Electrical Overload
Elementalist.description: Gain 10% more critical strike damage at rank 1 - +10% per additional rank (30% at 3/3).

Elementalist.name: Lightning Aegis
Elementalist.description: Gain 1% of your health as shield every time you apply a lightning debuff at rank 1 - +1% per additional rank (3% at 3/3).

Elementalist.name: Polar Flux
Elementalist.description: 15% more cold damage at rank 1 - +15% per additional rank (45% at 3/3), scaling from cold damage on your gear.

Elementalist.name: Blizzard
Elementalist.description: Gain 10% more critical strike chance at rank 1 - +10% per additional rank (30% at 3/3).

Elementalist.name: Chilling Aegis
Elementalist.description: Gain 1% of your health as shield every time you apply a cold debuff at rank 1 - +1% per additional rank (3% at 3/3).

Elementalist.name: Incinerate
Elementalist.description: 15% more fire damage at rank 1 - +15% per additional rank (45% at 3/3), scaling from fire damage on your gear.

Elementalist.name: Conflagration
Elementalist.description: Gain 10% multiplicative increased damage at rank 1 - +10% per additional rank (30% at 3/3).

Elementalist.name: Scorching Aegis
Elementalist.description: Gain 1% of your health as shield every time you apply a fire debuff at rank 1 - +1% per additional rank (3% at 3/3).

Elementalist.name: Gigantify
Elementalist.description: Thunder Golems get 100% more contribution from your health pool at rank 1 - +100% per additional rank (300% at 3/3) - base 33% of your health becomes 66/99/132%.

Elementalist.name: Growing
Elementalist.description: Thunder Golems gain 33% more maximum health each time they reform at rank 1, 66% at rank 2, 100% at rank 3 - stacking within a combat.

Elementalist.name: Terrifying
Elementalist.description: When a Thunder Golem dies, it explodes dealing 33% of its health as damage to enemies at rank 1, 66% at rank 2, 100% at rank 3.

Elementalist.name: Volcanic Ash
Elementalist.description: Flame Golems inherit 33% of your multiplicative increased fire damage at rank 1, 66% at rank 2, 100% at rank 3.

Elementalist.name: Blazing
Elementalist.description: Flame Golems gain 6% multiplicative attack speed at rank 1, 9% at rank 2, 18% at rank 3 (irregular scaling - see this file's own note above).

Elementalist.name: Surging
Elementalist.description: Flame Golems deal 10% multiplicative damage at rank 1 - +10% per additional rank (30% at 3/3).

Elementalist.name: Replenishing
Elementalist.description: Water Golems convert all damage they deal into healing for the party at a 100% rate at rank 1 - +100% per additional rank (300% at 3/3).

Elementalist.name: Singing
Elementalist.description: All allies gain 10% more effect from shields and heals applied to them at rank 1 - +10% per additional rank (30% at 3/3).

Elementalist.name: Shattering
Elementalist.description: When an enemy dies in the Water Golem's presence, it explodes, sending icicles at (splash + 1) nearby enemies at rank 1 - +1 per additional rank (splash + 3 at 3/3), each dealing damage equal to 1% of the dead enemy's health.
